title: Remove explicit tracks
statementMd:
Delete all explicit tracks, then report how many tracks and how many plays of the remaining tracks exist (two columns).

Expected columns: `tracks`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
DELETE FROM tracks WHERE explicit = 1; SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks) AS tracks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plays WHERE track_id IN (SELECT id FROM tracks)) AS plays;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
